title: Prepositions after verbs (3)
summary: Глаголы с **in, with, into, of, to**: **believe in, provide sb with, turn into, consist of, look forward to** (+ -ing) и глаголы без предлога (**enter, attend, marry**).
ru:
## in: вера, успех, специализация
**in** употребляется с глаголами, которые обозначают участие, вложение и результат.
> **believe in** — верить в существование, идею, ценность: *I believe in hard work.* — Я верю в упорный труд. (А **believe somebody / something** — верить человеку, его словам: *I don't believe his story.*)
> **succeed in** + -ing — *She succeeded in finding a publisher.* — Ей удалось найти издателя.
> **specialise in**, **participate in**, **take part in**, **invest in**, **engage in**, **involve sb in**.
> **result in** — приводить к (следствие): *The strike resulted in huge losses.*; **result from** — быть следствием: *The losses resulted from the strike.*
Ловушки: ~~succeed to do~~ → succeed **in doing**; ~~participate to~~ → participate **in**.

## with: снабжать, справляться
- **provide / supply / equip / present** somebody **with** something — *The school provides every pupil with a laptop.* Эквивалент: **provide** something **for** somebody (*provides laptops for every pupil*). ~~provide them equipment~~ → provide them **with** equipment.
- **cope / deal / struggle with**: *She coped well with the pressure.*
- **collide / agree / compare with**: *The car collided with a lorry.* **charge sb with** (a crime), **replace sth with sth**.

## into: превращение, проникновение, столкновение
**into** — переход в новое состояние или внутрь.
> **turn / change / convert into** — *The old factory was turned into a gallery.* — Старую фабрику превратили в галерею.
> **translate / divide / cut into** — *The book was translated into twelve languages.* / *Divide the class into groups.*
> **break / run / bump / crash into** — *Burglars broke into the office.* / *I ran into an old friend.* — Я случайно встретил старого друга.
> **look into** — расследовать, изучать: *The police are looking into the matter.*
Обратите внимание: **turn to** — обратиться к кому-то (*turn to a lawyer*) или повернуться, а **turn into** — превратиться.

## of и to: состав, одобрение, отношение
- **of**: **consist of** (~~consist from~~), **approve of** (*She approves of the plan*; без of — одобрить официально: *The board approved the plan*), **dispose of**, **die of** (болезнь).
- **to** (предлог!): **object to**, **look forward to**, **admit / confess to**, **contribute to**, **lead to**, **belong to**, **respond / react to**, **be married to**, **be used to**. После предлога to употребляется **-ing**: *I'm looking forward to meeting you.* (не ~~to meet~~).
> The new law led **to** a rise in prices. — Новый закон привёл к росту цен.
> She confessed **to** taking the money. — Она призналась, что взяла деньги.

## Глаголы без предлога
Эти глаголы требуют прямого дополнения; предлог добавлять нельзя: **enter** a room, **approach** a town, **reach** a decision, **resemble** a relative, **attend** a meeting, **marry** somebody, **mention** a problem, **await** a reply.
- ~~She married with a doctor.~~ → She **married** a doctor. / She **is married to** a doctor.
- ~~He entered into the room.~~ → He **entered** the room. (*enter into* — вступать в соглашение, в разговор: *enter into negotiations*)
- ~~We attended to the conference.~~ → We **attended** the conference. (*attend to* = заниматься: *attend to a customer*)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I'm looking forward to see you.~~ → I'm looking forward to **seeing** you.
- ~~The firm provided us equipment.~~ → provided us **with** equipment.
- ~~She succeeded to pass.~~ → She succeeded **in passing**.
- ~~It consists from three parts.~~ → It consists **of** three parts.
en:
## in: belief, success, specialisation
**in** goes with verbs of participation, investment and result.
> **believe in** — to trust that something exists or has value: *I believe in hard work.* (But **believe somebody / something** means to accept it as true: *I don't believe his story.*)
> **succeed in** + -ing — *She succeeded in finding a publisher.*
> **specialise in**, **participate in**, **take part in**, **invest in**, **engage in**, **involve sb in**.
> **result in** — to cause: *The strike resulted in huge losses.*; **result from** — to be caused by: *The losses resulted from the strike.*
Traps: ~~succeed to do~~ → succeed **in doing**; ~~participate to~~ → participate **in**.

## with: supplying and coping
- **provide / supply / equip / present** somebody **with** something — *The school provides every pupil with a laptop.* The equivalent is **provide** something **for** somebody (*provides laptops for every pupil*). ~~provide them equipment~~ → provide them **with** equipment.
- **cope / deal / struggle with**: *She coped well with the pressure.*
- **collide / agree / compare with**: *The car collided with a lorry.* **charge sb with** (a crime), **replace sth with sth**.

## into: change, entry, impact
**into** shows a change of state or movement inside.
> **turn / change / convert into** — *The old factory was turned into a gallery.*
> **translate / divide / cut into** — *The book was translated into twelve languages.* / *Divide the class into groups.*
> **break / run / bump / crash into** — *Burglars broke into the office.* / *I ran into an old friend.* (= met by chance)
> **look into** — to investigate: *The police are looking into the matter.*
Note: **turn to** means to ask someone for help (*turn to a lawyer*) or to face someone, while **turn into** means to become something else.

## of and to: composition, approval, attitude
- **of**: **consist of** (~~consist from~~), **approve of** (*She approves of the plan*; without of it means to officially accept: *The board approved the plan*), **dispose of**, **die of** (an illness).
- **to** (a preposition!): **object to**, **look forward to**, **admit / confess to**, **contribute to**, **lead to**, **belong to**, **respond / react to**, **be married to**, **be used to**. After the preposition to we use **-ing**: *I'm looking forward to meeting you.* (not ~~to meet~~).
> The new law led **to** a rise in prices.
> She confessed **to** taking the money.

## Verbs with no preposition
These verbs take a direct object and no preposition: **enter** a room, **approach** a town, **reach** a decision, **resemble** a relative, **attend** a meeting, **marry** somebody, **mention** a problem, **await** a reply.
- ~~She married with a doctor.~~ → She **married** a doctor. / She **is married to** a doctor.
- ~~He entered into the room.~~ → He **entered** the room. (*enter into* means to begin something formal: *enter into negotiations*)
- ~~We attended to the conference.~~ → We **attended** the conference. (*attend to* = to deal with: *attend to a customer*)

## Common mistakes
- ~~I'm looking forward to see you.~~ → I'm looking forward to **seeing** you.
- ~~The firm provided us equipment.~~ → provided us **with** equipment.
- ~~She succeeded to pass.~~ → She succeeded **in passing**.
- ~~It consists from three parts.~~ → It consists **of** three parts.
structure:
## Группы глаголов по предлогу
| Предлог | Глаголы | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| in | believe, succeed, specialise, participate, invest, result | specialise in law |
| with | provide, supply, equip, cope, deal, collide, charge | cope with stress |
| into | turn, change, translate, divide, break, run, crash, look | translated into French |
| of | consist, approve, dispose, die | consists of six parts |
| to | object, lead, contribute, belong, respond, confess, look forward | lead to delays |
| (нет) | enter, approach, reach, resemble, attend, marry, mention | marry a doctor |

## Формулы
> provide **sb with** sth = provide **sth for** sb
> look forward / object / be used **to** + **-ing**
> result **in** (следствие) ≠ result **from** (причина)
> translate **from** A **into** B

## Сравнение
| Конструкция | Значение |
|---|---|
| enter a room | войти (физически) |
| enter into talks | вступить (в формальный процесс) |
| attend a meeting | присутствовать |
| attend to a client | заниматься клиентом |
| turn into | превратиться |
| turn to | обратиться (за помощью) |

exercises.title: Вставьте предлог
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужный предлог. В скобках — варианты, из которых нужно выбрать.

items.text: She specialises {{in}} cardiology and has published widely.
The heavy rainfall resulted {{in}} severe flooding downstream.
The hotel provides all guests {{with}} a free breakfast.
The magician turned the scarf {{into}} a white dove.
The article was translated {{from}} Japanese {{into}} English.
Burglars broke {{into}} the gallery last night.
I'm looking forward {{to}} meeting your parents.
Her mother approved {{of}} the new design and did not ask for changes.
The committee consists {{of}} twelve elected members.
A cut in taxes led {{to}} higher consumer spending.
It took her months to cope {{with}} the loss of her job.
Many residents objected {{to}} the new motorway.
The firm has invested heavily {{in}} renewable energy.
He confessed {{to}} stealing the money from the safe.
She is married {{to}} an architect from Prague.
How did the government respond {{to}} the crisis?
The car skidded and crashed {{into}} a wall.

items.q: He believes ___ hard work, not luck.
The train is approaching ___ the station.
The company equipped its staff ___ new laptops.
Who will attend ___ the meeting on Monday?
The caterpillar eventually turns ___ a butterfly.

exercises.title: Перефразируйте
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя глагол из подсказки.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **consist of**: The team has eight engineers and two designers.
answers: The team consists of eight engineers and two designers.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **result in**: The mistake caused a serious delay.
answers: The mistake resulted in a serious delay.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **turn into**: The old factory became a modern art gallery.
answers: The old factory turned into a modern art gallery.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **provide ... with**: The organisers gave every participant a free map.
answers: The organisers provided every participant with a free map.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **approve of**: She thinks that his decision is good.
answers: She approves of his decision.

items.prompt: Rewrite with **look forward to**: I can't wait to see the results.
answers: I'm looking forward to seeing the results.
I am looking forward to seeing the results.
I look forward to seeing the results.
I'm looking forward to the results.
I am looking forward to the results.
He specialises in tax law.
He specializes in tax law.
He specialises in taxation law.
He specializes in taxation law.
She copes well with stress.
She copes well with the stress.
She is coping well with stress.
She is coping well with the stress.

items.prompt: Книгу перевели с русского на английский. (translate)
answers: The book was translated from Russian into English.
The book has been translated from Russian into English.
They translated the book from Russian into English.

items.prompt: Я не возражаю против этого плана. (object)
answers: I don't object to this plan.
I do not object to this plan.
I don't object to the plan.
I do not object to the plan.
She is married to a director.
She's married to a director.
She is married to a film director.
She's married to a film director.

items.prompt: Мы с нетерпением ждём встречи с вами. (look forward)
answers: We look forward to meeting you.
We're looking forward to meeting you.
We are looking forward to meeting you.
We look forward to seeing you.
We're looking forward to seeing you.
We are looking forward to seeing you.

items.sample: I believe in honesty and hard work.

items.prompt: What are you looking forward to this month?
items.sample: I'm looking forward to visiting my grandparents.

items.prompt: What kind of things do you find hard to cope with?
items.sample: I find it hard to cope with noise when I'm working.

items.prompt: Have you ever run into someone unexpectedly? Where and who?
items.sample: Last year I ran into an old classmate at the airport.

items.prompt: Who or what do you belong to (a club, a team, a community)?
items.sample: I belong to a small running club in my neighbourhood.
